text: dsh-session-mirror 是面向 DSH desktop 的会话备份插件。它在启动、每轮对话结束和关闭时备份本机会话日志，并注册对话工具与菜单命令。主要功能包括逐会话增量备份、生成主子会话索引、按标题或 ID 查找并恢复会话，以及清理子会话备份和可选的到期回收。适合希望本机保留 DSH 会话副本并在需要时恢复的用户。无需 API 密钥或外部服务；备份目录可通过配置指定。

dsh-session-mirror backs up DSH desktop sessions locally at startup, after turns, and on shutdown. It provides per-session backups, indexes, restore by title or ID, and sub-session cleanup. No API key or external service is needed; the backup directory is configurable.
想给 DSH 的每段对话单独留一份本地备份。
DSH 误删会话后，有办法从备份找回来吗？
让 DSH 在每轮对话结束后自动保存会话日志。
我想按标题关键词快速找回以前的对话。
需要区分主会话和子 agent 会话来整理备份。
有没有办法预览将清理的子会话备份，再确认删除？
I want separate local backups for my DSH conversations.
Can I restore a deleted conversation by searching its title?
Automatically back up sessions after each chat turn.
dsh-session-mirror 的功能「自动增量备份」：在启动、每轮对话结束及关闭时扫描会话日志，按文件变化复制到备份目录，并生成会话索引。
dsh-session-mirror 的功能「查找并恢复会话」：通过对话工具或菜单命令输入标题关键词、跳字或 ID 前缀；先预览匹配结果，确认后将备份复制回会话目录并更新工作区登记。
dsh-session-mirror 的功能「清理子会话备份」：从对话工具、菜单命令或命令行预览要清理的子会话；确认后删除备份并将会话 ID 加入跳过列表。到期自动清理可选开启。

@kadima-code/dsh-session-mirror README · dsh-session-mirror：> English: [README.en.md](README.en.md)

一个纯 host 的 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）插件：把**每个对话各自备份成一份最新文件**，支持按需**恢复**、按规则**清理**，并在源被删除时**保留备份防误删**。

- 版本：`0.1.0` · 许可：BSD-3-Clause
- 形态：纯 host、零外部依赖（只用 Node 内置模块），无浏览器半 —— 不会崩应用
- 默认备份目录：`E:\DshChatBackup`

---

@kadima-code/dsh-session-mirror README · 它管哪几件事：1. **增量备份**：启动 / 每轮对话结束 / 关闭时自动备份；没变化的不重复拷，改了先拷临时文件、校验完整再原子替换。
2. **主 / 子识别 + 两份人读索引**：《对话总览.md》目录树、《对话清单.md/html》详表（状态、主/子、对话长度、开启/结束/归档/删除时间、到期）。
3. **一键恢复**：支持会话 ID 前缀、标题关键字、甚至只记得标题里跳着的几个字；先预览，`加 yes` 才真恢复。
4. **清理与到期回收站**：手动清理子对话备份；可选「到期自动清理」——到期先进回收站，留 7 天再真删。
5. **安全兜底**：只动备份不动原文件；坏帧绝不覆盖好文件；自动清理默认关闭。

---
@kadima-code/dsh-session-mirror README · 快速开始（安装）：本插件是标准 bundle 插件，安装 = 包落地 + profile 登记 + **完全重启 DSH**。

@kadima-code/dsh-session-mirror README · 方式一：npm（发布后）：```bash
npm i @kadima-code/dsh-session-mirror
```

随后在 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json` 登记（见下方「profile 登记」）。
@kadima-code/dsh-session-mirror README · 方式二：Release zip：把 zip 解压到 `~/.dsh/_plugins/dsh-session-mirror`，再按下方登记。
@kadima-code/dsh-session-mirror README · 方式三：本地目录 link：`dependencies` 里写 `"@kadima-code/dsh-session-mirror": "link:<插件目录绝对路径>"`。

@kadima-code/dsh-session-mirror README · 1）备份：**自动触发**：DSH 启动后约 8 秒、每轮对话结束（去抖 8 秒）、DSH 关闭时各跑一次。没有固定定时周期。

**增量规则**：按「文件大小 + 最后修改时间」判断——没有备份就全拷一份；已备份但没变化就跳过；有变化才重新拷贝。

**可靠性**：每次先拷到临时文件 → 校验 zstd 帧完整 → 才原子替换正式文件。因此**永远不会用半个文件盖掉好文件**。

**防误删**：源里已删除的会话，备份**保留**并标记 `orphaned`（已删除）。

**手动补一次**：对话里说「备份一下」，或用「+ → 指令」菜单 `mirror-backup`。

@kadima-code/dsh-session-mirror README · 2）主 / 子识别与两份索引：每个会话文件第一行是 `session` 头，含 `origin` / `parentSession` / `delegationDepth`。判定为**子对话**：`origin === 'subagent'` 或含 `parentSession` 或 `delegationDepth > 0`；否则为**主对话**。

插件在备份目录生成两份人读索引：

- **《对话总览.md》**：工作区 → 主对话 → 子对话 的目录树，附标题、时间、大小、备份路径，标出 活跃 / 归档 / 已删除 / 置顶；子对话用 🧹 标「少用·可清理」。
- **《对话清单.md》**（另出 `对话清单.html` 网页版）：13 列表格 —— 名字、状态、主/子、对话长度、大小、开启时间、结束时间、归档时间、删除时间、到期、备份时间、ID、工作区。

**对话长度**是复合指标：文件大小 + 我发消息条数 + AI 回复条数 + 最后活动时间/存活时长。超过 2MB 的大会话只解最后一帧取「最后活动时间」，避免逐条精算拖慢。
@kadima-code/dsh-session-mirror README · 2）主 / 子识别与两份索引：> 说明：开启/结束时间取自会话自带记录，**准确**；归档时间/删除时间只能是「插件第一次检测到」的时刻（DSH 本身不保存这两个时间），可能比你实际操作晚几分钟。

@kadima-code/dsh-session-mirror README · 3）恢复：**三种入口**：

- **对话里说**：「恢复对话：<标题里的字/词 或 ID 前缀>」
- **「+ → 指令」菜单**：`mirror-restore <字/词 或 ID>` → 先预览；`mirror-restore <字/词 或 ID> yes` → 真恢复
- **命令行**：`node tools/restore.mjs`（交互式）/ `--list` 只列可恢复的已删除主对话 / `<查询> --yes`；也可双击 `tools\一键恢复.bat`

**模糊匹配**：支持标题包含、跳字子序列（如「诗技」能对上「古诗词…技能」）、ID 前缀。命中唯一才自动选中；命中多个会把候选（名字·状态·ID 前 8 位）列出来让你再补字或报 ID，**绝不乱猜**。

**恢复做什么**：把该会话的备份文件拷回 `~/.dsh/sessions/<工作区>/<会话ID>/`，并把会话 id 回填到 `~/.dsh/storages/workspace.json` 对应工作区（若原为归档状态会自动取消归档）。回 DSH 按 F5 即可见。
@kadima-code/dsh-session-mirror README · 3）恢复：**安全**：默认先预览（dryRun）；目标已存在不覆盖、只补登记。

@kadima-code/dsh-session-mirror README · 4）清理与到期回收站：**手动清理子对话备份**：

- 对话里说「清理子对话备份」或菜单 `mirror-clean`（默认只预览，列出要清理的清单）
- 确认执行：菜单 `mirror-clean yes`，或命令行 `node tools/clean.mjs --yes`
- 清掉的会话 id 记入 `_mirror-clean-skip.json`，以后不再重新备份

**到期自动清理（默认关闭）**：打开后会按以下规则把到期的备份**先移入 `_回收站/`，再留 7 天**，之后才真删。

| 对象 | 规则 |
|---|---|
| 活跃的主对话 | **永不自动删** |
| 子代理 | 「子代理最后结束时间 距 主对话最后结束时间 > 3 天」才清（参照是主对话，不是当前时间） |
| 子代理（父主对话已被删除） | 父删日 + 7 天，取更早者 |
| 已删除的主对话 | 留 30 天（该条规则为可选项，默认未启用） |
| 归档的会话 | 不动 |
| 置顶 / 收藏 | 不参与判断（判断只看标记） |
@kadima-code/dsh-session-mirror README · 4）清理与到期回收站：开关：存在文件 `_mirror-autoclean.on`，或配置 `autoClean: true`。关闭状态下**只做标记与统计，绝不删除任何东西（回收站也不动）**。

@kadima-code/dsh-session-mirror README · 5）安全与已知限制：- **只动备份，不碰原文件**：所有删除都发生在 `E:\DshChatBackup` 内。
- **坏帧保护**：拷贝前校验 zstd 帧完整性，不合格的副本会被丢弃并保留旧副本。
- **两阶段删除**：到期先进 `_回收站`，留 7 天再真删，中途可反悔捞回。
- **自动清理默认关闭**：需你显式开启才执行。
- **已知限制**：
  - 归档时间 / 删除时间是「插件第一次检测到」的时刻，不是精确操作时间；
  - 大文件（>2MB）的对话长度只按最后活动时间近似；
  - DSH 内核升级后，建议先跑一次回归（备份 / 恢复 / 清理各一次）再长期使用；
  - 子对话备份清理后，若源仍在，会记入 skip 名单不再备份（避免反复备份-清理）。

---

@kadima-code/dsh-session-mirror README · 配置（profile 层传 config）：| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | 关闭后插件不执行任何备份 |
| `dest` | `E:\DshChatBackup` | 备份根目录 |
| `verbose` | `false` | 是否在日志里输出每份明细 |
| `autoClean` | `false` | 是否开启到期自动清理（也可用 `_mirror-autoclean.on` 开关） |

---

@kadima-code/dsh-session-mirror README · 备份目录里有哪些东西：```
E:\DshChatBackup\
  sessions\                每个对话的备份，目录结构与 ~/.dsh/sessions 一致
  _mirror-state.json       每份备份的状态（大小/时间/主或子/标题/是否已删除/指标）
  _mirror.log              每次运行记录（超 5MB 自动轮转为 _mirror.log.1）

---

@kadima-code/dsh-session-mirror README · dsh-session-mirror：> 中文: [README.md](README.md)

A pure-host plugin for DSH (DeepSeek Harness) that **keeps one up-to-date backup file per conversation**, with on-demand **restore**, rule-based **cleanup**, and **protection against accidental deletion** (backups of deleted sessions are kept).

- Version: `0.1.0` · License: BSD-3-Clause
- Shape: pure host, zero external dependencies (Node built-ins only), no browser half — it cannot crash the UI
- Default backup directory: `E:\DshChatBackup`

---

@kadima-code/dsh-session-mirror README · What it does：1. **Incremental backup** — runs on startup, after each turn, and on shutdown; unchanged files are skipped; a changed file is copied to a temp file, frame-validated, then atomically replaced.
2. **Main/sub conversation awareness + two human-readable indexes** — a tree (`对话总览.md`) and a detailed table (`对话清单.md` / `.html`) with status, main/sub, conversation length, timestamps and expiry.
3. **One-click restore** — accepts an ID prefix, a title word, or even a few scattered characters of the title; preview first, `yes` to actually restore.
4. **Cleanup with a recycle bin** — manual sub-conversation cleanup, plus an optional scheduled cleanup that moves expired backups to a recycle bin for 7 days before hard delete.
5. **Safety** — only backups are touched, never originals; a corrupt frame never overwrites a good file; scheduled cleanup is off by default.
@kadima-code/dsh-session-mirror README · Install：This is a standard DSH bundle: place the package, register it in the profile, then **fully restart DSH**.

@kadima-code/dsh-session-mirror README · Option 1: npm (once published)：```bash
npm i @kadima-code/dsh-session-mirror
```

Then register it in `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json` (see below).
@kadima-code/dsh-session-mirror README · Option 2: Release zip：Unzip into `~/.dsh/_plugins/dsh-session-mirror`, then register it.
@kadima-code/dsh-session-mirror README · Option 3: local link：Use `"@kadima-code/dsh-session-mirror": "link:<absolute path>"` in `dependencies`.

@kadima-code/dsh-session-mirror README · 1) Backup：**Triggers**: ~8s after startup, after each turn (debounced 8s), and on DSH shutdown. No fixed interval.

**Incremental**: compares file size + mtime — full copy if never backed up, skip if unchanged, re-copy only if changed.

**Reliability**: copy to a temp file → validate the zstd frame → atomic rename. An incomplete file can never overwrite a good one.

**Deleted source**: the backup is **kept** and marked `orphaned`.
@kadima-code/dsh-session-mirror README · 1) Backup：**Manual run**: say “备份一下”, or use the `mirror-backup` command from the “+” menu.

@kadima-code/dsh-session-mirror README · 2) Main/sub detection and two indexes：Each session file starts with a `session` header containing `origin` / `parentSession` / `delegationDepth`. A session is a **sub** conversation when `origin === 'subagent'`, or it has `parentSession`, or `delegationDepth > 0`; otherwise it is a **main** conversation.

Two indexes are generated in the backup directory:

@kadima-code/dsh-session-mirror README · 2) Main/sub detection and two indexes：- `对话总览.md` — a tree (workspace → main → sub) with title, time, size, path, and status (active / archived / deleted / pinned); sub conversations are marked 🧹 “low-use · cleanable”.
- `对话清单.md` (plus `对话清单.html`) — a 13-column table: name, status, main/sub, conversation length, size, start/end/archived/deleted times, expiry, backup time, ID, workspace.

@kadima-code/dsh-session-mirror README · 2) Main/sub detection and two indexes：**Conversation length** is a composite metric: file size + user message count + assistant reply count + last-activity time / lifespan. Sessions over 2 MB only decode the last frame to get the last-activity time.

> Note: start/end times are accurate (from the session log). Archived/deleted times are the moment the plugin **first detected** them — DSH does not store those timestamps.

@kadima-code/dsh-session-mirror README · 3) Restore：**Three entry points**:

- In chat: “恢复对话：<title word or ID prefix>”
- “+” menu command: `mirror-restore <query>` → preview; `mirror-restore <query> yes` → restore
- CLI: `node tools/restore.mjs` (interactive) / `--list` / `<query> --yes`; or double-click `tools\一键恢复.bat`

@kadima-code/dsh-session-mirror README · 3) Restore：**Fuzzy matching**: title substring, character subsequence (e.g. “诗技” matches “古诗词…技能”), or ID prefix. A unique match is chosen automatically; multiple matches are listed (name · status · first 8 chars of ID) so you can narrow it down. It never guesses.

**What restore does**: copies the backup back to `~/.dsh/sessions/<workspace>/<sessionId>/` and re-registers the ID in `~/.dsh/storages/workspace.json` (un-archiving automatically if needed). Press F5 in DSH to see it.
@kadima-code/dsh-session-mirror README · 3) Restore：**Safety**: preview by default; never overwrites an existing file.

@kadima-code/dsh-session-mirror README · 4) Cleanup and recycle bin：**Manual sub-conversation cleanup**:

- `mirror-clean` in the “+” menu (preview only), or say “清理子对话备份”
- Execute: `mirror-clean yes`, or `node tools/clean.mjs --yes`
- Cleaned IDs are recorded in `_mirror-clean-skip.json` so they are not backed up again

**Scheduled cleanup (off by default)**: when enabled, expired backups are **moved into `_回收站/` first**, kept 7 days, then hard-deleted.

@kadima-code/dsh-session-mirror README · 4) Cleanup and recycle bin：| Target | Rule |
|---|---|
| Active main conversation | **never auto-deleted** |
| Sub-agent | deleted when “sub's last end time is more than 3 days before the main conversation's last end time” |
| Sub-agent whose parent main was deleted | parent deletion + 7 days (earlier wins) |
| Deleted main conversation | 30 days (optional rule, disabled by default) |
| Archived session | never touched |
| Pinned / bookmarked | irrelevant (decision is based on status marks only) |

@kadima-code/dsh-session-mirror README · 4) Cleanup and recycle bin：Enable with the `_mirror-autoclean.on` marker file or `autoClean: true`. When off, it only marks and reports — **it deletes nothing, not even from the recycle bin**.

@kadima-code/dsh-session-mirror README · Configuration (profile config)：| Key | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | Disable to stop all backups |
| `dest` | `E:\DshChatBackup` | Backup root |
| `verbose` | `false` | Log per-file details |
| `autoClean` | `false` | Enable scheduled cleanup (or use `_mirror-autoclean.on`) |

@kadima-code/dsh-session-mirror README · Backup directory layout：```
E:\DshChatBackup\
  sessions\                one file per conversation, same structure as ~/.dsh/sessions
  _mirror-state.json       state per backup (size/time/main-or-sub/title/orphaned/metrics)
  _mirror.log              run log (rotated to _mirror.log.1 above 5 MB)

@kadima-code/dsh-session-mirror README · Command / tool cheat sheet：| Task | Chat tool | “+” menu | CLI |
|---|---|---|---|
| Back up now | `session_mirror_now` | `mirror-backup` | — |
| Restore | `session_mirror_restore` | `mirror-restore <query> [yes]` | `tools/restore.mjs` |
| Clean sub-conversations | `session_mirror_clean` | `mirror-clean [yes]` | `tools/clean.mjs [--yes]` |
| Show expiry | — | — | `tools/clean.mjs --expiring` |
| Toggle scheduled cleanup | — | — | `tools/clean.mjs --auto-on` / `--auto-off` |
| Purge recycle bin (>7d) | — | — | `tools/clean.mjs --purge` |

@kadima-code/dsh-session-mirror README · Command / tool cheat sheet：> “+” menu command names must be lowercase ASCII; append parameters after the command (e.g. `/mirror-restore 作图`).
